caption:
Apparently writing a book wasn’t enough. My characters need a soundtrack too 📖

This is “Waking Moments,” a new song I wrote from the perspective of one of the characters in a book I’m writing. It’s about someone taking up basically every thought in your head.

Her story, but I definitely know the feeling 💗

#WakingMoments #OriginalSong #TeenSongwriter #GirlsWhoWrite #Bookish

For the best friend who lives way too far away 💗

I wrote “What It Takes” for my best friend’s birthday, about doing whatever it takes to be together again. I miss her so much 😭

Send this to the friend you wish lived next door 🫶

#LongDistanceBesties #BestFriendSong #GirlsWhoWriteSongs #TeenSongwriter #OriginalSong
